column1: # 雅思核心词汇 List 04（i 10271–10360）。每行：编号§单词§例句§译文（译文里恰好一处 **…** 标出对应词义）
10271 § audit § An independent audit found no accounting errors. § 一次独立**审计**未发现任何会计差错。
10272 § benchmark § Productivity is measured against industry benchmarks. § 生产率是对照行业**基准**来衡量的。
10273 § brand § The brand is well known for its quality. § 这个**品牌**以质量著称。
10274 § budget § The government has cut the education budget. § 政府削减了教育**预算**。
10275 § capital § Start-ups often need capital to grow. § 初创企业往往需要**资金**才能发展壮大。
10276 § commodity § Oil is one of the world's most traded commodities. § 石油是全球交易最频繁的**大宗商品**之一。
10277 § competition § Fierce competition forces firms to innovate. § 激烈的**竞争**迫使企业不断创新。
10278 § contract § She signed a two-year employment contract. § 她签了一份为期两年的劳动**合同**。
10279 § corporation § The multinational corporation employs over 50,000 people. § 这家跨国**公司**雇用了五万多人。
10280 § credit § Easy credit encourages people to overspend. § 宽松的**信贷**会促使人们过度消费。
10281 § currency § The local currency has weakened against the dollar. § 当地**货币**兑美元已经走弱。
10282 § debt § Many students graduate with heavy debts. § 许多学生毕业时背负着沉重的**债务**。
10283 § deficit § The country runs a large trade deficit. § 该国存在巨额贸易**逆差**。
10284 § demand § Demand for housing far exceeds supply. § 住房**需求**远远超过供应。
10285 § depreciation § Currency depreciation makes imports more expensive. § 货币**贬值**使进口商品更加昂贵。
10286 § distribution § Income distribution has become more unequal. § 收入**分配**变得更加不平等。
10287 § dividend § The company pays an annual dividend to shareholders. § 该公司每年向股东派发**股息**。
10288 § economy § The economy is growing at a steady pace. § **经济**正以稳定的速度增长。
10289 § efficiency § Automation greatly improves production efficiency. § 自动化大大提高了生产**效率**。
10290 § enterprise § Small enterprises create most new jobs. § 小型**企业**创造了大部分新增就业岗位。
10291 § entrepreneur § The young entrepreneur built a successful online business. § 这位年轻的**企业家**创办了一家成功的网络企业。
10292 § equity § The founders kept most of the equity in the company. § 创始人保留了公司的大部分**股权**。
10293 § expenditure § Government expenditure on healthcare has risen. § 政府在医疗保健方面的**支出**有所增加。
10294 § export § The country's main exports are electronics and cars. § 该国的主要**出口商品**是电子产品和汽车。
10295 § fiscal § The government adopted an expansionary fiscal policy. § 政府采取了扩张性的**财政**政策。
10296 § forecast § Economic forecasts are often revised. § 经济**预测**常常会被修正。
10297 § franchise § He opened a fast-food franchise in the city centre. § 他在市中心开了一家快餐**特许经营**店。
10298 § GDP § GDP per capita is a common measure of prosperity. § 人均**国内生产总值**是衡量繁荣程度的常用指标。
10299 § growth § Economic growth has slowed in recent years. § 近年来经济**增长**有所放缓。
10300 § import § The country imports most of its oil. § 该国**进口**其大部分石油。
10301 § incentive § Tax incentives encourage companies to invest in R&D. § 税收**激励措施**鼓励企业投资研发。
10302 § inflation § Rising inflation erodes the value of savings. § 不断上升的**通货膨胀**侵蚀着储蓄的价值。
10303 § investment § Foreign investment has created thousands of jobs. § 外国**投资**创造了数千个就业岗位。
10304 § labour § The factory relies on cheap labour. § 这家工厂依靠廉价**劳动力**。
10305 § liability § The company's liabilities exceed its assets. § 公司的**负债**超过了其资产。
10306 § market § The company expanded into new overseas markets. § 公司拓展到了新的海外**市场**。
10307 § merger § The merger created one of the largest banks in the region. § 这次**合并**造就了该地区规模最大的银行之一。
10308 § monetary § The central bank tightened monetary policy. § 央行收紧了**货币**政策。
10309 § monopoly § The state held a monopoly on telecommunications. § 国家**垄断**了电信业务。
10310 § negotiate § Workers negotiated for higher wages. § 工人们为更高的工资进行了**谈判**。
10311 § outsource § Many firms outsource customer service overseas. § 许多公司把客户服务**外包**给海外。
10312 § partnership § The two companies formed a strategic partnership. § 两家公司结成了战略**合作关系**。
10313 § portfolio § Investors should diversify their portfolios. § 投资者应当分散自己的**投资组合**。
10314 § productivity § Investment in training boosts productivity. § 对培训的投入能提高**生产率**。
10315 § profit § The company reported a record annual profit. § 该公司公布了创纪录的年度**利润**。
10316 § procurement § The procurement process must be transparent. § **采购**流程必须透明。
10317 § recession § Many businesses went bankrupt during the recession. § 许多企业在**经济衰退**期间破产。
10318 § regulation § New regulations restrict the use of plastic bags. § 新**法规**限制塑料袋的使用。
10319 § return § The investment delivered a high return. § 这项投资带来了很高的**回报**。
10320 § revenue § Advertising is the main source of the website's revenue. § 广告是这个网站**收入**的主要来源。
10321 § risk § Starting a business involves considerable risk. § 创业涉及相当大的**风险**。
10322 § shareholder § Shareholders will vote on the proposal. § **股东**将对该提案进行表决。
10323 § subsidy § The government provides subsidies to farmers. § 政府向农民提供**补贴**。
10324 § surplus § The trade surplus narrowed last year. § 去年贸易**顺差**收窄。
10325 § tariff § Tariffs on imported steel were increased. § 进口钢材的**关税**被提高了。
10326 § taxation § High taxation can discourage investment. § 高额**税收**可能抑制投资。
10327 § trade § Free trade benefits both countries. § 自由**贸易**对两国都有利。
10328 § unemployment § Unemployment among young people remains high. § 年轻人中的**失业**率依然很高。
10329 § wages § Wages have not kept pace with inflation. § **工资**的增长没有跟上通货膨胀的步伐。
10330 § workforce § A skilled workforce attracts foreign investment. § 熟练的**劳动力**能吸引外国投资。
10331 § economic growth § Education contributes directly to economic growth. § 教育直接促进**经济增长**。
10332 § supply chain § The pandemic disrupted global supply chains. § 疫情扰乱了全球**供应链**。
10333 § amendment § The constitution was changed by a new amendment. § 宪法因一项新的**修正案**而被修改。
10334 § arbitration § The dispute was settled through arbitration. § 这起纠纷通过**仲裁**得到了解决。
10335 § authority § Local authorities are responsible for public safety. § 地方**当局**负责公共安全。
10336 § civil law § Civil law deals with disputes between individuals. § **民法**处理个人之间的纠纷。
10337 § coalition § The two parties formed a coalition government. § 两个政党组成了**联合政府**。
10338 § constitution § Freedom of speech is guaranteed by the constitution. § 言论自由受**宪法**保障。
10339 § corruption § Corruption undermines public trust in government. § **腐败**损害公众对政府的信任。
10340 § criminal § The criminal was sentenced to ten years in prison. § 这名**罪犯**被判处十年有期徒刑。
10341 § custody § The suspect was taken into police custody. § 嫌疑人被警方**拘留**。
10342 § democracy § The court protects the foundations of democracy. § 法院维护着**民主**的根基。
10343 § detention § He was held in detention for questioning. § 他被**拘留**以接受审问。
10344 § diplomatic § The two nations restored diplomatic relations. § 两国恢复了**外交**关系。
10345 § due process § Everyone is entitled to due process of law. § 每个人都有权获得**正当法律程序**。
10346 § election § The election was held in a peaceful atmosphere. § **选举**在平和的气氛中举行。
10347 § enforcement § Enforcement of the new law begins next month. § 新法的**执行**将于下月开始。
10348 § fraud § He was convicted of insurance fraud. § 他因保险**欺诈**被定罪。
10349 § government § The government introduced stricter safety regulations. § **政府**出台了更严格的安全法规。
10350 § human rights § Human rights must be protected by law. § **人权**必须受到法律保护。
10351 § illegal § It is illegal to drive without a licence. § 无证驾驶是**非法**的。
10352 § judiciary § An independent judiciary is vital to democracy. § 独立的**司法机构**对民主至关重要。
10353 § jurisdiction § The case falls within the court's jurisdiction. § 这起案件属于该法院的**管辖范围**。
10354 § legislation § New legislation protects consumer rights. § 新的**立法**保护消费者权益。
10355 § legitimate § The court decided that the claim was legitimate. § 法院裁定该项诉求是**正当**的。
10356 § liability § The company admitted liability for the accident. § 公司承认对这起事故负有**法律责任**。
10357 § lobby § The industry lobby opposed the new regulation. § 行业**游说团体**反对这项新规定。
10358 § mandate § The new government has a clear mandate for reform. § 新政府有明确的改革**授权**。
10359 § mediation § Mediation helped the two sides reach an agreement. § **调解**帮助双方达成了协议。
10360 § parliament § The bill was approved by parliament. § 该法案获得了**议会**批准。
